plan: OpenVibe Development Roadmap (combined), Wave 1; implementation plan rev 3 section 3.1
deployment: none of its own: a library and artifact repository published as release tags; services pin a tag and deploy it with their own releases
contracts: openvibe-contracts v0.106.0 (this package; the newest tag)
features: 589 JSON Schemas with valid and invalid fixtures
205 capability manifests and the staff capability map
validate, ids, http (problem+json, trace and idempotency middleware), capabilities.check and serviceAuth
generated TypeScript types, JSON Schema bundle and per-service OpenAPI 3.1
compatibility check against the previous tag (scripts/compat.js)
generated estate: docs/ESTATE.md and manifests/repositories/ from the checkouts (scripts/estate.js; --check fails on drift)

chat.ticket-conversation@1 and the active chat.ticket.write capability: a per-ticket conversation keyed by ticket id and calling service, with author_kind person|agent|staff (POST /internal/chat/tickets/:ticket_id/messages and GET /internal/chat/tickets/:ticket_id)
chat.dm-block-state-result@1: Chat's DM block-state read ({ blocked }, GET /internal/chat/dm/block-state) joined to chat.messages.read's route list
platform.task@1 (planned, owner network) and ADR-044: one task at OpenVibe.Actor's router with a mode, a per-task and per-day budget, result, cost and explanation, SSE progress, cancel and webhooks

watch.watch@1 and the other Watch contracts (plan T18, planned), three watch events, four capabilities and the placeholder service manifest: user-defined persistent observations over pages, feeds, APIs, events and devices

chat.site-daily-result@1, chat.first-chat-result@1 and chat.sound-result@1: Chat's three new internal reads (kind site-daily for Live's home series, the welcome check, and the sound a !command plays), with chat.stats-request@1 now accepting kind site-daily and the two route lists extended
network.resource.read (active, ADR-048): OpenVibe.Network's resource index, GET /api/v1/resources (common.resource-list-result@1) and GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn (common.resource-summary@1)
